configuration.latencyMethod: Separate pass after throughput batches, two high-resolution monotonic counter reads per call; Windows Go uses QueryPerformanceCounter with frequency resolved before workers and delta ticks converted to ns, portable Go uses time.Now/time.Since, Node uses process.hrtime.bigint; per-worker closed loops, no queue/HTTP; digest updated after each individual timer.
configuration.cpuMethod: Whole-process cumulative user+system CPU surrounding each throughput batch, including all worker/runtime/GC threads and measurement-call overhead.
